whyAnping.title: The Wire Mesh Capital of China
whyAnping.desc: Anping County in Hebei Province produces the majority of China's wire mesh — an estimated 80% of national output. Over 20,000 factories and workshops cover the full spectrum: stainless steel woven mesh, welded mesh, fence panels, gabion baskets, expanded metal and perforated metal. Decades of clustered supply chains mean competitive pricing, deep technical know-how, and fast sampling.
